name: Meryl Hathaway
source:
The heroine of the third episode.

A mysterious girl who follows [url=/c112732]Kotoko[/url] around. 

A slender girl who is usually in a daze, which gives the impression of being a fragile person. However, when an emergency situation arises, she shows unusual skills that are not of an ordinary person.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1190392&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]

[spoiler]'Meryl Hathaway' is an alias she was given when she came to Japan, and her real name is Emma.[/spoiler]
